svg.title: Ratio control of the additive pump
svg.desc: When the carrier steps from 100 to 150 litres per minute, the additive target jumps to 15 litres per minute and the pump command to 100 percent; the ratio is back within 0.005 of 0.1 after 0.9 seconds. When the carrier stops, the pump command goes to 0 percent at once, yet the decaying pump flow still delivers 0.174 litres of additive within 5 seconds.
svg.text: Ratio control of the additive pump
Control Studio recording of this project · carrier 100 → 150 L/min on one station, 100 → 0 L/min on the other · numbers answer the predictions
Target 15 L/min at once; the pump
Still 0.174 L of additive by 5 s
